name: PolyCup
author: Kiki
description: Simple live Cups for 2–8 racers: one track pick each, finalist scoring, smooth POV spectating, PB and record panels.
changelog: Slim the bottom-center spectator dock to 44 pixels, with the racer name on a white inset trapezoid.
Use square arrow-only previous/next buttons; retain bracket shortcuts and direct racer selection.
Move the watched racer personal best into a short bottom-right card and remove live time/speed from the dock.
